ideas.title: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent charges of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and explore the ongoing investigation
questions: How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What steps are being taken to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. I recommend starting with public records and interviewing sources close to the investigation.
